host_environment.note: Same x86_64-under-Rosetta-2 build as native_kv_handoff_latency_fixed_sha256_result.json (scripts/build-kv-handoff.sh). Weight loading happens once, outside the timed repeats, so this isolates the actual transfer computation from the load latency measured separately.

method: Native FASM/Accelerate tensor-kv-handoff binary, in-process repeats after weight loading (excluded from both buckets, measured separately as native_latency_fixed_sha256). Fixed cost = sender prefill of the 32-symbol sequence + handoff_import, paid once. Marginal cache-query cost = one receiver query against the already-imported cache. No native re-prefill counterpart exists to compare against (the 6-layer receiver has no native from-raw-text CLI), so no breakeven query count is computed here, unlike the PyTorch-reference-environment amortized_latency sources.
